top_signals.title: Saudis Deepen Capital Market Reforms With Derivatives Push
top_signals.summary: Saudi Arabia is stepping up efforts to deepen its capital markets, making it cheaper and easier to trade derivatives as it seeks to attract more investors and trading firms.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: With No Heirs, Kuehne’s Foundation Gets His $49 Billion Fortune
top_signals.summary: Klaus-Michael Kuehne’s death signals the end of a swashbuckling dealmaking era for the German tycoon’s empire while transferring his $49 billion fortune to a low-key Swiss foundation.
